title: HCrispy Wholesome SaltCod Pilaf
description: A nutty, crisp Irish dish featuring sous-vide cooked salt cod, ideal for a sick-day meal. This anti-inflammatory-friendly recipe combines the richness of salt cod with wholesome ingredients like brown rice and sunflower seeds.
instructions: Soak the salt cod overnight in cold water.
Rinse brown rice and sunflower seeds. Chop garlic finely.
Combine salt cod, brown rice, sunflower seeds, chopped celery, Worcestershire sauce, and enough water to cover all ingredients.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 45 minutes or until the rice is tender.
Add red pepper flakes if desired. Stir well and serve hot.
Optional: To achieve a nuttier flavor, sauté sunflower seeds in a pan before adding them to the pilaf.
